text:
eric: Kicking off late-window deploy for release-2025.04.01. Services: api, runtime, console, router. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% over 15m, then 50% -> full. Pin runtime to v3.2.1 and console to v4.1.0 (no schema changes). @maya @leo @sam please watch your stacks. Any objections before I hit /deploy?

deploy-bot: Received. Dry-run OK. Will execute wave orchestration and report stage transitions. Command queued:
```
/deploy release-2025.04.01 --services api,runtime,console,router --canary 5,25,50 --pin runtime@v3.2.1 console@v4.1.0 --quiet-window 02:00-04:00UTC
```

maya: quick note — runtime has a slightly elevated kv-eviction rate on canaries from yesterday. Recommend enabling conservative batch_size and prefix cache for canary nodes.

eric: good catch. We'll set runtime.batch_size=8 for canary and enable prefix-cache=true. Add to command?

leo: router header-split is on a staged flag in prod. If traffic moves fast it could expose header mismatch errors for older clients. Request we start router at 2% not 5% for the canary and verify header mapping logs for 10m.

eric: agree — adjusting canary to 2% -> 10% -> 25% ramp, extend observation windows to 15m for the first two steps.

sam: console will flip feature-flag ui.experimental=false for the canary group to avoid mixing new frontend paths. I'll watch dashboard latency panels.

deploy-bot: Starting canary wave 1 -> 2% for services: api,runtime,console,router. Pod rollout started. Notifying monitoring hooks.

oncall-bot: FYI: baseline P95 latency for API is 120ms, error rate 0.12%. Alert thresholds: error_rate>=1% OR P95>=200ms for 10m.

nina: seeing a small surge of background job retries in staging infra — could amplify kv pressure. If we see kv-evictions > 0.5% hold and scale canary nodes.

eric: acknowledged. Rollback/on-hold criteria = any of: errors>1% sustained 10m, P95 > 200ms 10m, kv-evictions >0.5% 5m, or router mapping errors >10 in 10m. If triggered we pin traffic back to 0% and rollback runtime to v3.2.0.

deploy-bot: Canary 2% stable at +8m. Metrics: errors 0.14%, P95 125ms, kv-evictions 0.08%. No router mapping errors. Proceeding to 10% per updated plan.

maya: with the lowered batch_size and prefix-cache the backend looks healthy. continuing to watch memory and GC.

leo: router logs show a handful of 400s linked to legacy header parsing — but 6 total in last 7m, below concern threshold. continuing.

eric: thumbs up from me. @sam please validate console UX path at 10% and confirm no regressions in telemetry.

sam: checked main dashboard, no spike in bundle size or render errors. all good. moving forward. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 25% after extended observation. Watching for rollback triggers.

neric: final note for release notes: call out runtime kv-cache behavior change and console flag toggle. ops runbook updated with rollback commands and pin list.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if hold required, run:
```
/deploy rollback release-2025.04.01 --service runtime --to v3.2.0 --notes "kv-eviction spike"
/deploy pin traffic --service router --percent 0
```

eric: thanks all — leaving this thread open for any late anomalies. Approvals: eric, maya, leo, sam.

deploy-bot: Thread closed for activity but will post final completion event when rollout completes. :white_check_mark:
